description: FreeCAD is open with a real T8 lead screw housing bracket model (T8_housing_bracket.FCStd from the FreeCAD parts library). The bracket is a parametric PartDesign model with a pad, holes, and a polar pattern of mounting holes. Export the 3D solid to STL format. To do this: first select the 'Body' object in the model tree on the left panel (the PartDesign body contains the complete bracket solid), then go to File > Export, choose 'STL Mesh (*.stl *.ast)' as the file format, and save the file as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/exported_model.stl'. Make sure the Body is selected (highlighted) before exporting.
